summary: Skier triggered an avalanche slide in the G8 zone of Highland Bowl at Aspen Highlands while several skiers were in the area; the skier fought to avoid burial and escaped missing only one ski; all others accounted for, no one buried. Sheriff's Office press release posted by MRA.
location: Highland Bowl, G8 zone, Aspen Highlands Ski Resort
notes: No injuries and no burial; SAR response to reported avalanche with multiple skiers nearby.
